purpose: One fixed genre-only fractional logistic artist-style predictor versus training prior and genre TF-IDF kNN regression; development folds0..3 only, no reserved fold4 confirmation or model selection.

pre_freeze_knowledge.known: Prior human-genre NB/temperature results and negative unsupervised instrument addition on genre and development style coherence; native identities, development style availability and fixed original folds. This is a new supervised development endpoint on a reused historical cohort, not an unseen cohort. No alternative candidate/regularization/fold reseeding search. One independent count-only development census was inspected before freeze:87 training-only genre tags in every fold; no IDF, vectors, cosines, model fits or metrics computed. The independent count-only census also observed zero feature-empty queries in each development fold; these counts are feasibility knowledge, not model outcomes.
not_seen_for_this_task: new IDF matrices or cosine neighbors
logistic coefficients, objectives, convergence or predictions
new proper prediction scores or bootstrap intervals
any reserved fold4 style fractions, predictions or scores

source.runtime_inputs: Only externally pinned new protocol plus the two exact approved raw files. Historical pins document custody/reservation; no old scores, models, profiles, geometry, receipts or absolute paths required at runtime.

identity_and_reservation.identity_first: Bounded identity-only parse of BOTH full metadata/human files; exact native join including canonical track/artist/album/path/duration; components built on all metadata via shared artist OR album before any tag or target extraction. Deduplicate exact native IDs only, never names.
identity_and_reservation.component: Minimum native track ID in full artist/album connected component.
identity_and_reservation.roles: Folds0,1,2,3 development; fold4 reserved. Each development query uses ONLY a model and feature bank excluding its whole original fold AND fold4.
identity_and_reservation.skip_boundary: After identity/role resolution, skip each reserved row BEFORE genre-tag extraction and selected-style extraction. Do not call old coherence.load_source or old style.source because they parse reserved covariates. Reuse only pinned identity/canonicalization helpers and role-safe selected-token parsing.
identity_and_reservation.reserved_payload: Identity, original fold, metadata-only counts and constant role status reserved_skipped ONLY. This status is NOT an outcome or label-availability assessment. No tag_counts, style/target container, feature vector, model probability, neighbor, score or per-artist style eligibility/count, even null/NaN placeholders.
identity_and_reservation.interpretation: Label-held-out target reservation in a previously inspected cohort. Earlier unsupervised geometry used reserved unlabeled metadata, but this NEW feature context excludes it entirely. No confirmation in this slice; future fold4 study requires separate candidate/protocol freeze before any reserved target extraction.

labels.tokens: For attribute a only literal a and not_a. Exactly3recognized votes including disagreements; no normalization or aliases; duplicate selected cells error. Missing/empty, wrong count and invalid tokens distinct; never negative by default.
labels.artist_target: For each attribute, equal mean of eligible track positive fractions; y_a=sum eligible positive votes/(3*eligible tracks). Artist complete iff all5attributes have>=1eligible track; robust iff all5have>=2. Track raw vote sequences are not serialized; retain counts/reasons and development artist positive/negative/eligible-track support.
labels.weights: Source assertion gives one artist per component, so each complete training/evaluation artist weight is EXACTLY1. No row/track/vote/positive-class reweighting. Component bootstrap therefore equals artist bootstrap.
labels.population: Preserve all558development outcomes, including11unjudged. Predict all558 regardless query label availability; score fixed547complete,446robust secondary. Keep155reserved identity-only outcomes separate. Heldout label support NEVER controls fitting/prediction or class omission.
labels.sampling_expectation: Uniformly choose one eligible artist/component, then one eligible track of that artist for the attribute, then one recorded vote. This yields the equal-track artist fraction; do not weight artists by track/vote count.

features.allowed: Canonical uploader genre---[a-z0-9]{1,64} ONLY, deduplicate tag presence within each metadata track.
features.artist_frequency: Track presence count for genre tag divided by ALL native metadata tracks of that artist, including empty-tag and unannotated tracks.
features.vocabulary: For each query fold f sorted union of literal genre tags present in ALL metadata artists in dev folds other than f. df>=1; no human-eligibility selection, no global/reserved vocabulary, no query-derived scaling.
features.matrices: Native artist IDs ascending, vocabulary lexicographic; deterministic float64. Query unseen tags reported and ignored by current training vocabulary; no vocabulary expansion.

prior: Per training complete artist/attribute: (1+sum(y_a))/(2+N_complete), Beta(1,1) artist pseudo-counts; same prior for all queries in that fold.

knn.feature_bank: N=ALL training metadata artists, including empty/unjudged; DF=number with tag present; IDF=ln((1+N)/(1+DF))+1. Multiply raw artist frequencies by IDF and normalize each full genre row to unit L2; zero rows stay zero.
knn.candidates: ONLY complete labeled training artists, one per component. Entire query fold and reserved fold4 excluded before bank construction. Target mask selects regression neighbors only, never vocabulary/DF.
knn.distance: Sorted float64 query matrix @ sorted labeled-gallery matrix transpose. Require finite raw cosine>0; permit <=1+1e-12 roundoff without clipping/epsilon reranking.
knn.ranking: Descending exact computed cosine, then component minimum track ID, then artist ID ascending; top10, no zero-score padding.
knn.prediction: For each attribute compute math.fsum(cosine_i*y_i)/math.fsum(cosine_i) over selected raw-positive cosine neighbors; do not normalize individual weights then dot. This is cosine-weighted mean and preserves convex endpoints without posthoc clipping. If query feature-empty/unseen-only or no positive labeled overlap, use same fold training Beta prior with explicit distinct reason and empty neighbors.
knn.roundoff: No probability clipping, rounding or adjustment. math.fsum numerator/denominator with nonnegative targets in[0,1] must give finite probability in[0,1]; otherwise abort atomically. Accept raw cosine<=1+1e-12 roundoff but never clip/rerank it.

logistic.features: Raw per-artist genre frequencies in training vocabulary, NOT TF-IDF; no other normalization.
logistic.objective: For each attribute independently MINIMIZE SUM_i[logaddexp(0,b+x_i@w)-y_i*(b+x_i@w)] +0.5*(w@w). Each complete artist weight1; do NOT divide by N. Fixed C=1 across all folds. Bias b unpenalized. Training objective unclipped stable BCE; no logloss clipping inside optimization.
logistic.initialization: All coefficients and bias exactly0; no warm start or previous-fold/model reuse.
logistic.convergence: Require optimizer success, all parameters/objective/gradients/probabilities finite, gradient infinity norm<=1e-5 and final objective<=zero-init objective+1e-10. No retries, expanded iterations, alternate solver or silent baseline fallback. Convergence failure aborts atomically before publishing result artifacts.
logistic.prediction: expit(b+x_query@w) for all development queries including empty-feature and unjudged rows. Empty features use learned bias, NOT forced prior.
logistic.fit_accounting: Exactly20attempted logistic fits for supported pinned data:4development cells*5attributes. Maximum20 PER resource-bounded run invocation; replay independently recomputes same20 as a separate verification invocation. Four training-only vocabulary/IDF banks per run/replay; census has only count derivations, zero IDF normalizations/cosines/logistic fits.
logistic.solver_choice: L-BFGS-B and all stated options are fixed before outcomes; no algorithm comparison or search. Independent Newton solution may verify the same convex objective but is not another candidate.

gates.source: Fail census if exact source identity/component assertions or role boundaries change.
gates.per_training_fold_attribute: At least5distinct complete components with positive vote evidence(y>0), at least5 with negative evidence(y<1), and strictly0<sum y<N. No-finite-optimum all0/all1 is explicit unsupported cell, never a fit or fallback.
gates.unsupported: Retain all source roles/outcomes and exact unsupported cell reasons in census. If ANY cell unsupported, entire planned comparison unsupported and run does not fit or publish model probabilities/scores; do not drop attributes/folds or reseed.
gates.query: No heldout-label-dependent gates. Per-class query support descriptive only.

primary: Artist/component-equal macro expected individual-vote binary logloss
Artist/component-equal macro expected individual-vote binary Brier
metrics.logloss: Positive contribution=-y*log(max(p,1e-15)); negative contribution=-(1-y)*log(max(1-p,1e-15)). For the unclipped negative term use log1p(-p) equivalently; if 1-p<1e-15 use log(1e-15). This is max-only log clipping, with NO upper cap, probability modification or renormalization. Brier uses raw probabilities. Report counts per method/attribute: positive clipping when p<1e-15 AND y>0; negative clipping when 1-p<1e-15 AND y<1. Also report respective probability-threshold counts regardless target coefficient, and distinct affected artists with either nonzero weighted clipped term.
metrics.brier: p*p-2*p*y+y = y*(1-p)^2+(1-y)*p^2; raw probabilities, not (p-y)^2 and not doubled two-class Brier.
metrics.aggregation: Compute each artist/attribute loss then equal mean over all5attributes and547complete artists. Report all5attribute metrics and positive/negative contributions separately; no class prevalence reweighting. Prevalence and positive/negative component/vote/eligible-track support explicit.
metrics.secondary: Same metrics on446predeclared robust query artists, same fitted models/priors/kNN banks. All4fold reports and all5attribute reports; no cherry-picked attributes/subsets.

uncertainty.method: Paired bootstrap of query components/artists conditional on the fixed four training banks/predictions; descriptive exploratory reused-cohort uncertainty, not independent-corpus or listening validation. Reuse identical draws for all methods/attributes/positive-negative-total contributions.
uncertainty.pairing: Resample whole native components, exactly one artist here, with all5attributes/all3methods jointly; identical component draw indices for every method/attribute/positive-negative-total contrast. Sign is first named method minus second named method; lower proper losses are better.
uncertainty.draw_convention: For each subset separately sort eligible query components ascending. Generate rng.integers(0,n,size=(2000,n)) once with the declared PCG64 seed: ordinary n-with-replacement resampling, each index independently uniform0..n-1 (n=547primary/446robust on pinned data). Unstratified across fixed development folds; do not resample training banks or refit. Reuse this identical draw matrix jointly across all5attributes/allmethods/allpositive-negative-total parts.

metrics.limitations: Historical annotator independence/blinding unknown; uploader genre is predictor, human style fractions source annotations rather than artist membership or listener relevance. Prior instrument candidate remains negative; new supervised findings do not promote any research artifact or prove EveryNoise parity.

Historical study artifacts not inputs.
